alternative_explanations: Any advantage may come only from bounded persistence regularization or local support ridge rather than cross-world representation transfer; the independent, cross-family-only and support-only source-identical roles discriminate these explanations.
Dense affine recurrence may be a classical DMDc/ARX effect rather than a novel principle; strong ridge, RLS and autoregressive controls constrain the claim.
confounds: The three locally visible benchmark families are screening evidence, not a hidden evaluator; no LLM-successor or scaling-law claim is admissible.
Thresholds are frozen from development-only artifacts before implementation, runner seed realization or v6 scoring.

invalidation_rules: Invalidate if any candidate receives a family label, source path, native type or semantic channel name.
Invalidate if normalization reads a holdout output or any value outside assigned slow-fit worlds.
Invalidate if a history, support or forecast window crosses a whole-world or DS08a cycle boundary.
Invalidate if shared, independent, cross-family-only or support-only changes learner source or hyperparameters.
Invalidate if masked loss is not averaged within world and equally across the three evaluator-private families.
Invalidate if acquisition, normalization, fit, adaptation, query, update, bytes, state or R1/R4/R16 cost is omitted.
Invalidate on post-score tuning, scoring-seed leakage, external model/API use or evaluator-integrity change.

falsification_criteria: Discard if any family/K shared-versus-independent or cross-family-only-versus-support-only NRMSE gain is <= 0.03806855146519833.
Discard if shared fails to beat persistence and the strongest complete implementable control by > 0.03806855146519833 in any family/K cell.

Discard if worst-family accuracy trails persistence by > 0.008823017208322348, stability is below 1.0, query work grows with K, adaptation mutates global state, or a simpler implementable baseline Pareto-dominates.

Invalidate on source/constant mismatch across roles, correction beyond +/-4 standardized units, ridge mismatch, channel-permutation failure, family/path/native-type/semantic-name access, post-score tuning, external model/API, omitted cost, semantic baseline, preflight or integrity failure.

outcome_policy.negative: Conclude the WT success does not transfer through this exact source-identical recurrent residual rule; preserve the failure and abandon this exact mechanism.
outcome_policy.null: Treat any mixed-sign, below-threshold or Pareto-dominated pattern as negative and do not tune ridge, bound, features or update law.
outcome_policy.positive: Keep the exact mechanism only for unchanged replication; do not mark promising from one seed.

predicted_outcome: Conjunctive positive requires in every family and K=4/6/9: shared over independent and cross-family-only over support-only NRMSE gains greater than 0.03806855146519833, shared advantage over persistence and strongest complete implementable control greater than 0.03806855146519833, worst-family accuracy within 0.008823017208322348 of persistence, stability 1.0, permutation equivariance, session-local adaptation, K-independent query work and universal full-cost Pareto non-dominance. Threshold artifact is research/checks/three_family_recurrent_residual_v6_preregistered_thresholds.json.
promotion_criteria: This one-seed quick cannot promote; a full conjunctive positive can only authorize an unchanged multi-seed replication in a later wake.
research_question: Can one source-identical family-blind bounded recurrent residual learner transfer across unseen N-CMAPSS, DronePropA and continuous-event worlds better per full cost than independent, cross-family-null and classical controls?
title: Three-family bounded recurrent residual adversarial quick
